symbols.name: dice::ref2::world::EngineTemplate::makeScript
symbols.note: Binds .con command names to EngineTemplate field offsets by writing them out again. In ITS base: setTorque +0x414, setDifferential +0x410, setNumberOfGears +0x40c (int, default 1), setGearUp +0x418 (default 0.3), setGearDown +0x41c (default 0.7), setGearChangeTime +0x420 (default 1.0), setNoPropellerEffectAtSpeed +0x5cc (default 100.0), HeatIncrement +0x5d4 (default -1.0), CoolingFactor +0x5d8, setHeatBarType +0x5dc, InverseHeatBar +0x5e0. Add 4 to reach the base the physics code uses. This is the evidence that settles which of setTorque/setDifferential drives thrust.

symbols.name: dice::ref2::world::WingTemplate::makeScript
symbols.note: Binds .con names to WingTemplate offsets. In ITS base: setWingLift +0x25c (default 1.0), setFlapLift +0x260 (default 0.1), setPitchOffset +0x264 (default 0.0), setPositionOffset +0x268/+0x26c/+0x270, regulateToLift-enabled bool +0x274, setRegulateToLift +0x278, setWingToRegulatorRatio +0x27c. Add 4 for the base PhysicsWing holds at +0x9c; PhysicsWing's second template pointer at +0xa0 is that base +0x100, which is why the lift coefficient reads as +0x160/+0x164 there - those are setWingLift and setFlapLift.

symbols.name: PointPhysicsNode::updatePositionalDragSimple
symbols.note: dragAccel -= (scale*v - wind) * pi * arg1^2 * dragField(+0x38) * (1/mass(+0x3c)) into accel accumulator. Drag is wind-relative and area/mass-scaled, NOT plain -drag*v. arg1 from virtual +0x1c (getBoundingRadius per lnxded vtable order, working); arg2 scale = 1 + 24*clamp(field(+0x44)/arg1, 0, 1) - the 25x factor and field +0x44 meaning are open (water submersion suspected).

symbols.name: PointPhysicsNode positional integrator (4 substeps)
symbols.note: Semi-implicit Euler, 4 fixed sub-steps of dt/4: each does v += accel*h (vel at +0x10..0x18, accel accumulator at +0x1c..0x24) THEN accumulates pos delta with the updated v. Epilogue writes position via virtual +0x38 and zeroes the accel accumulator.

symbols.name: PointPhysicsNode::updatePhysics (drag+integrate+gravity seed)
symbols.source: decompiled; assert string 'Mass 0 when calculating drag.'
symbols.note: Order per call: (1) if drag>0 apply dragSimple, (2) run 4-substep integrator with dt, (3) re-seed accel.y += getGravity()*gravityModifier(+0x40) for next update. Name from role match with lnxded PointPhysicsNode::updatePhysics(float); not signature-proven.

symbols.name: BasicPhysicsSystem::BasicPhysicsSystem
symbols.source: byte-identical field init to lnxded ctor; vtable 0x008fdbe8
symbols.note: Defaults: gravity(+0x8) = 0xC16BAE14 = -14.73; wind(+0xc..+0x14) = 0; airDensityZeroAtHeight(+0x30) = 1000.0. No caller overrides gravity at init or map load (all 31 xrefs to singleton DAT_0097d770 audited: ctor, 3 chat cheats, Physics console get/set, rest are getters).

symbols.name: BasicPhysicsSystem::airDensityZeroAtHeight default (1000.0)
symbols.note: The BasicPhysicsSystem ctor at 0x00578f00 seeds field +0x30 with 0x447a0000 = 1000.0f. Offset identified by dice::ref2::world::BasicPhysicsSystem::setAirDensityZeroAtHeight at 0x08251f20 in bf1942_lnxded.static, which writes +0x30. Both PhysicsWing::updatePhysics and PhysicsEngine::updatePhysics multiply by 1 - clamp(y/this, 0, 1), so lift AND thrust fade linearly with altitude and reach zero at 1000 m. No vanilla .con authors it. This address is the field's location within the singleton, not a static - the ctor's store is at 0x00578f4x.

symbols.name: dice::ref2::world::PhysicsEngine::getCurrentRatio
symbols.note: returns 3.5 * EngineTemplate.setDifferential / lerp(gearRatioCurve, (gear/numberOfGears)*100). THIS is the scalar that multiplies aircraft thrust. Template base here is queryInterface(0x8c230)-0x260, which is EngineTemplate::makeScript's base +4 (fixed by setNoPropellerEffectAtSpeed appearing at makeScript+0x5cc and at updatePhysics+0x5d0). setDifferential therefore sits at +0x414 in this base and setTorque at +0x418. The gearRatioCurve's default contents were NOT read; for setDifferential 5 the shipped top speeds only work out if it is ~1.0. Linux twin: 0x0824ca70.

symbols.name: dice::ref2::world::PhysicsEngine::getCurrentTorque
symbols.note: returns lerp(torqueCurve[101], |throttle|*100) * EngineTemplate.setTorque (base+0x418). Called from exactly one place in the whole binary - feedbackLoop - where it only normalises the engine-load ratio. setTorque therefore does NOT scale thrust. Linux twin: 0x0824cb10, likewise single-caller.

symbols.name: dice::ref2::world::PhysicsEngine::feedbackLoop
symbols.note: feedbackLoop(Vec3 force BY VALUE, const Vec3& dir). ratio = getCurrentRatio() * dot(force, dir) / getCurrentTorque(); clamped to +-1 when EngineTemplate flag bit 1 is set; then folded into the engine's RPM state: this[+0xa4] = ((this[+0xac]*this[+0xa4] + ratio)*0.99)/(this[+0xac]+1) when flag bit 2 is clear, else a directional peak-hold. The force argument is passed by value and the caller re-derives the applied force afterwards, so nothing feedbackLoop does can reach the thrust. This is the RPM/sound path. Linux twin: 0x0824c850.

symbols.name: dice::ref2::world::PhysicsEngine::updatePhysics
symbols.note: Thrust. Found via the PhysicsEngine vtable at 0x008fdf50. rho = 1 - clamp(pos.y/getAirDensityZeroAtHeight(), 0, 1); e = throttle - rho*(vel . fwd)/EngineTemplate.setNoPropellerEffectAtSpeed; K = 0.1*|throttle| + e*|e| (a SIGNED SQUARE, not the linear fade flight-model.md 6 assumes); force = fwd * K * getCurrentRatio(), applied at the ENGINE NODE'S OWN POSITION (not the CoM) via rootNode vtable+0x68. setTorque is absent from this expression. Medium gate: an engine runs only when its EngineTemplate flag bit 3 matches the medium (submerged vs air), which is what separates c_ETShip from c_ETPlane. Tail is prop visuals: spin rate = throttle*400 below |throttle|<0.08, else throttle*20. Linux twin: 0x0824cbb0.

symbols.name: PhysicsSpring::updatePhysics
symbols.source: decompiled; assert strings 'Root parent not mobile in spring.', 'Child not composite object in spring.'
symbols.note: Spring accel = -(setStrength * displacement * getGravity()*(-0.101833 = -1/9.82) + setDamping * d(displacement)/dt), applied at wheel contact via addAccelerationAt (virtual +0x6c). Gravity-normalized: at default g=-14.73 springs act at 1.5x .con strength. Also: c_PGFRollGripWhenOccupied wheels get grip rewritten to 10 (Roll|?) when vehicle occupied (+0x11e), 9 (Contact|?) when empty - parked vehicles do not roll away.

symbols.name: dice::ref2::world::calculateLift
symbols.note: THE lift equation, whole. calculateLift(const Vec3& vel, const Vec3& unused, const Vec3& surfaceUp, float coeff) -> acceleration m/s^2. len=|vel|; if len==0 return 0; s=clamp(dot(vel/len, surfaceUp),-1,1); a=asin(s)*57.29578 (DEGREES); c = 0 if |a|>=45 else a*(45-a)/506.25 for a>=0, a*(45+a)/506.25 for a<0; return (0.75*c + 0.25*s) * len*len * coeff * 0.0025. SPEED EXPONENT IS 2 (len*len), settling flyable-vehicles/flight-model.md 9c item 1. Peak coefficient 1.0 at 22.5 deg, hard zero at +-45 deg = a built-in stall model. MSVC folded /506.25 into *0.0019753086419753087, which is why a byte search for 506.25 misses. Small-angle slope: 0.75*45/506.25 + 0.25*pi/180 = 0.07103 per degree = 4.0699 per radian. Matched instruction-for-instruction against dice::ref2::world::calculateLift at 0x0824eb20 in bf1942_lnxded.static (which carries a 4th leading Vec3 param that the body never reads).

symbols.name: dice::ref2::world::PhysicsWing::updatePhysics
symbols.note: Per-surface aero. Found via the PhysicsWing vtable at 0x008fead8. coeff = (WingTemplate.setWingLift + WingTemplate.setFlapLift) * getGravity() * -0.101833 (= -1/9.82), i.e. the two .con lift values are SUMMED into one coefficient and scaled by g/9.82 = 1.49995 at the shipped g=-14.7295. There is no separate flapLift*deflection term: hinge deflection reaches the maths only through the surface's world matrix. force = -clamp(calculateLift(...) * medium, -200, 200) * surfaceUp(row1 of the surface matrix), applied as an ACCELERATION at the surface's world position via rootNode vtable+0x68. medium = 10.0 when below the water/terrain height (World vtable+0x5c), else 1 - clamp(y/getAirDensityZeroAtHeight(), 0, 1). Regulator, gated on WingTemplate+0x278: recomputes the flow as parentForward*|v|, then wingObj[+0x15c] = clamp((L_ref + calculateNeutralLift(refFlow, -setPitchOffset, coeff)*setWingToRegulatorRatio + setRegulateToLift) * getGravity() * 0.101833, -1, +1) - a proportional servo command, which is why setRegulateToLift 4.91 really is 'hold this surface at 4.91 m/s^2'. Linux twin: 0x0824ed10.

symbols.name: dice::ref2::world::Wing::calculateNeutralLift
symbols.note: calculateNeutralLift(const Vec3& refFlow, float minusPitchOffset, float coeff). Builds identity Mat4, rotates it by the passed angle (= -WingTemplate.setPitchOffset), composes with the wing's parent transform, extracts row 1, and calls calculateLift with it. So it is the lift the surface WOULD make undeflected at its authored incidence; setWingToRegulatorRatio weights it into the regulator error. This is the only place setPitchOffset is read in the update path - whether it also biases the surface's rest orientation at setup is NOT established. Linux twin: 0x08250690.

symbols.name: StandardMeshSubShader_applyRenderState
symbols.note: vtable 0x009061a4 slot +0x10; .rdata after the vtable holds the .rs attribute strings (envmap, materialSpecularPower, materialSpecular, materialDiffuse, blendDest, blendSrc...). Fields: +0x2d lighting -> D3DRS_LIGHTING, +0x2e lightingSpecular -> SPECULARENABLE, +0x2f twosided -> CULLMODE, +0x30 envmap (stage1/2 setup), +0x31 transparent, +0x34/+0x38 blendSrc/Dest, +0x3c alphaTestRef, +0x44 material index -> SetMaterial(base + i*0x44). THE combine for lit StandardMesh (vehicles/statics): stage0 COLOROP=MODULATE2X, ARG1=TEXTURE, ARG2=DIFFUSE - i.e. pixel = clamp01(2 * tex * clamp01(vertex fixed-function diffuse)). Unlit path (lighting false) sets D3DRS_LIGHTING=0 and stage0 SELECTARG1(TEXTURE). NOTE: FUN_00664560's MODULATE 1x is a different, simpler renderer path, NOT the StandardMesh one.

symbols.name: RendPCDX8_flushDeferredState
symbols.note: Deferred render-state queue flusher: dispatch loop applying queued states to the device. Cases include SetMaterial(+0xA8) from queue at 0x9c0568, D3DRS_AMBIENT (0x8b) global ambient, D3DRS_*MATERIALSOURCE (0x91+), SetLight(+0xB0) for 8 slots via FUN_0045f210, LightEnable(+0xB8). Confirms fixed-function D3D lighting drives DIFFUSE for dynamic meshes.

symbols.name: RendPCDX8_flushMaterialStages
symbols.note: DX8 material flush for the SIMPLE texture path (param+0x90008 texture cache): stage0 MODULATE(1x, TEXTURE x DIFFUSE); no-texture SELECTARG DIFFUSE; +0x5e flag path ADD(TEXTURE,TFACTOR) then stage1 MODULATE(CURRENT,DIFFUSE). NOT the StandardMesh path - vehicles/statics go through StandardMeshSubShader_applyRenderState 0x005bf690 which uses MODULATE2X. Do not calibrate mesh lighting off this function.
